source_kind_note: Issuer's official 'Data Download' spreadsheet (Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=iShares-20-Year-Treasury-Bond-ETF_fund.xls; SpreadsheetML XML, worksheets Disclaimers/Holdings/Historical/Performance/Distributions). Classified as issuer_csv because it is the issuer-hosted structured data download; format is XLS, not CSV.
fetch_method: python requests GET with browser User-Agent, inside the default sandbox (no sandbox override needed). The download link was taken from the href in the TLT product page HTML.

cross_check.description: TLT product page HTML fetched at the same time; its Distributions section is server-rendered with the full 289-row table as JSON (walrus-render-on-client componentprops.distributionTableData, extracted to /tmp/claude-1000/-home-b90-prism/a3a82832-90e1-4e4f-a4ed-ac289ce72644/scratchpad/distributions/TLT_distribution_component.json). Outer-merge on ex-date against the XLS Distributions sheet: 289 matched, 0 left-only, 0 right-only, 0 payable-date mismatches, 0 amount mismatches (tol 1e-9).

parsing_notes: The XLS is SpreadsheetML XML; the whole file is not well-formed (a bare '&' inside a Disclaimers-sheet hyperlink), so the <ss:Worksheet ss:Name="Distributions"> block was extracted by regex, bare ampersands escaped, and parsed with xml.etree; rows -> pandas DataFrame. Sheet has 1 header row + 289 data rows, no footer/notes rows. Dates parsed with format '%b %d, %Y' (0 failures). amount = 'Total Distribution', which equals Income + ST Cap Gains + LT Cap Gains + Return of Capital on every row (max abs diff < 1e-9); ST/LT cap gains and return of capital are 0 on all 289 rows, so every record is a cash income distribution. No reinvested/undistributed capital-gain rows and no split/stock-distribution rows exist in the sheet, so nothing was excluded. No duplicate ex-dates, so no summing was needed. Zero rows with amount <= 0. Amounts written with 6 decimals as published (USD per share). Calendar check: every month from 2002-09 to 2026-09 has exactly one ex-date except December (two: regular early-December plus a late-December year-end distribution) and January (none) in every year 2002-2026 -- the standard iShares bond-ETF distribution calendar, not a data gap. Two records post-date the requested 2026-07-17 coverage end and are retained: ex 2026-08-03 (0.330454, paid 2026-08-06) and ex 2026-09-01 (0.314686, payable 2026-09-04; declared and past ex-date but not yet paid at capture time). Filter on ex_date <= 2026-07-17 if a hard cutoff is needed (287 rows). Record Date is present in the source but not written to the CSV. Guessed legacy .ajax download URLs (fileType=csv|xls, fileName=TLT_distributions, dataType=fund) returned HTTP 200 with the HTML product page as the body rather than a data file and were discarded.
